prior_offices: Deputy treasurer, Lincoln County (24 years, including 18 years under Jerry Greenfield and six years under Kathy Tomassi, as stated on the Antilla For Treasurer campaign site)
background: Joey K. Antilla is the Lincoln County treasurer-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Jerry Greenfield, who is serving through the current term. The Antilla For Treasurer campaign site states that she is a lifelong resident of Kemmerer and has served as deputy treasurer for 24 years, including 18 years under Greenfield and six years under Kathy Tomassi. SVI-NEWS reported that she won the August 2026 Republican primary with 2,783 votes over Dawn Marquardt and that the general-election race was then unopposed.
